entities.name: Query ATP synthase alpha
observations: 508 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 55.9 kDa and theoretical pI 4.85.
Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt B2A3G4, annotated as ATP synthase subunit alpha.
Contains ATP-synt_ab_N PF02874, ATP-synt_ab PF00006, and ATP-synt_ab_C PF00306 domains.
Homologs Q3A944 and Q2RFX7 are reviewed ATP synthase alpha subunits with 71.8% and 69.9% identity, respectively.

entities.name: B2A3G4
observations: Reviewed Natranaerobius thermophilus ATP synthase subunit alpha; exact sequence match to the query.
Annotated as the regulatory alpha subunit of proton-translocating F-type ATP synthase; EC 7.1.2.2 and Rhea RHEA:57720.
Forms an alpha3-beta3 ring with beta subunits and surrounds part of the gamma central stalk; peripheral membrane-associated CF1 component.

entities.name: F-type ATP synthase proton-coupled ATP production
observations: Reference reaction: ATP + H2O + 4 H+(in) = ADP + phosphate + 5 H+(out), Rhea RHEA:57720.
The alpha subunit is regulatory and contributes to the ATP synthase complex rather than being the primary catalytic beta-subunit site.

entities.name: Proton-transporting ATP synthase complex
observations: The protein is annotated to the membrane-associated F-type ATP synthase complex, which couples proton-gradient dissipation to ATP synthesis.
